data.body:
[P2] Require successful progress from the timeout retry

Both deadline cases can report `retry-replay` as passed when the retry emits `ENTER` and then fails or remains suspended. This checker only requires another request and one execution of the original success body; the caller never checks the victim's terminal result, and teardown stops unfinished executions. Require successful victim completion with the expected result and `after-deadline` work attributed to a retry request. Add a negative control where the retry enters but makes no durable progress.
